title: Recognition Cluster Merge Candidates Response
description: GET /recognition/clusters/{cluster_id}/merge-candidates. Ranked other clusters for a probe cluster. Similarity is centroid cosine merged with pending ClusterMergeSuggestion similarity. band is cut from the accepted calibration policy block in settings/clustering.py — no literal thresholds in the route. Same shape family as GET /recognition/clusters/{cluster_id}/roster-candidates. Consumers MUST render in payload order and MUST NOT re-sort (rg-015).

cluster_id.description: Probe cluster UUID from the request path.

candidates.description: Server-ranked other clusters. Similarity DESC, then name ASC within band. Browser/SPA clients must render in payload order.

name.description: Cluster label used for display and within-band name ASC. Empty string when the cluster is unlabeled; never fabricated from another cluster.

similarity.description: Ranking cosine only; not a calibrated probability. May be negative (band none).

band.description: Suggestion band from the accepted calibration policy block. Same vocabulary as roster-candidates-response. Unknown values MUST be treated as none.
